notes: Inbound SMB lead from marketing. Primary product interest: hosted API for in-app chat/support. Initial complaint: perceived latency on short chat responses after self-serve signup. Environment: single-page React webchat, single server in us-west2 but account default region was eu-west. Observed metrics reported by customer: p50 ~120-200ms, p95 ~600-900ms, occasional spikes >1s. Customer quote: 'We're seeing 600-900ms p95 — is that expected for hosted API? Feels sluggish compared to our earlier prototype.' Customer is price-conscious (small monthly run rate expected) and wants low-friction fixes before committing to paid plan.
use_case_summary: SMB chat/support bot embedded in web app. Short-turn conversations (1-3 user messages) and occasional longer context for ticket summarization. Targets: low latency for UX-sensitive messages, cost-conscious per-token spend.
performance_targets: Target p95 latency <300ms for short replies; throughput modest (peak 10-20 qps). Cost target: keep monthly inference under $5k.
integration_notes: Client was using default 10s HTTP timeout; some requests aborting when streaming enabled. App is sending full conversation history (~800 tokens) on every turn. Using synchronous single-request model calls (no explicit batching).
recommended_actions: Change account region to closest public cloud region (us-west2) - customer reported improvement after manual region switch
Set client HTTP timeout to 60s for streaming/long replies and 10-20s for short-turns depending on expected token length
Trim prompt context: send last N turns (recommend 3) and tokenize to ensure payload <400 tokens for typical short replies
Enable streaming responses to render tokens as they arrive (improves perceived latency)
Use prefix caching for repeated prompts and consider response caching for common queries
If throughput grows, consider batch endpoint or request-level concurrency limits to avoid tail latency spikes
SE to run latency profiling from customer's e2e stack during scheduled call and provide sample config (timeouts, region, example prompt truncation)
poC_plan: 2-week POC: 1) swap region to us-west2 and confirm p95 improvement; 2) implement streaming + client timeout changes; 3) measure cost delta and UX before/after; 4) handoff to account for pricing if targets met
